title: Gizmo Hover Without Camera Change
description: When hovering over the infinite-world viewport gizmo (WorldOrbitViewGizmo), the camera should not change — only the gizmo should show a hover effect. Click should still snap views via WorldOrbitViewSnapDriver. Fix for cad, puzzle3d, procedural consumers.
summary: Replaced drei GizmoViewport in WorldOrbitViewGizmo with WorldOrbitViewGizmoViewport that keeps axis-head hover scale feedback but does not call GizmoHelper tweenCamera on pointer down. Hover and press no longer animate the main camera; click still routes through onViewSelect → WorldOrbitViewSnapDriver for named view snaps. Fixes cad, puzzle3d, and procedural consumers that share WorldOrbitViewControls.
